description: A browser's bookmarks as a starting point: the exported bookmarks file, Chrome's Bookmarks JSON, or lines of urls. Each page is fetched onto the shelves as a collection (folder=? takes one folder); one that cannot be read becomes a source request. watch=true has the housekeeping re-read the pages and keep a new copy when one changes. Paths from the keeper only.

collection.description: The collection (default bookmarks, or the folder's name).

folder.description: Only the bookmarks in this folder.

limit.description: How many to take (default all, up to 200).

path.description: The bookmarks file on this machine (absolute path).

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

text.description: The urls, pasted, one per line.

name: library_bookmarks
